The Wolf Father (2026) | Sci-Fi Full Movie in 4K — Part 1

Her plane goes down in the frozen mountains. Before the wreck explodes, something tears the door off and drags her into the storm.

It should be a monster. It keeps saving her life.

Hunters in black armor are tracking it through the snow — a creature they call Subject 9. And when Lena finally reaches their abandoned station in the ice, she finds a locker with her own childhood photo inside.

The men who made him are coming back. This time, for both of them.

An original story — written from imagination, not adapted from any book, film or legend.

This film contains AI-generated visuals and synthetic voices.

Would you have trusted him — or run into the storm? Tell me in the comments.
